# Spark Agent

Spark Agent is a local-first AI content creation workbench for coding, documentation, presentations, web pages, file processing, multimedia generation, and cinematic infinite-canvas workflows.

## Key pages
- Homepage: /
- Features: /features
- Infinite Canvas: /canvas
- Architecture: /architecture
- Docs: /docs
- Download: /download
- GitHub: https://github.com/alexanderizh/spark-agent

## Core capabilities
- Local-first desktop AI workbench
- Infinite canvas for creative and film production
- Multi-agent team mode
- Claude SDK and Codex execution engines
- MCP and Skills ecosystem
- Multi-provider and multimodal model support
